## Architecture & Patterns
- The codebase is flat, with all files in the root directory.

- **No build or test commands**: Edit files directly and open `index.html` in a browser to view changes.

- **Debugging**: Use browser developer tools (F12) to inspect and debug HTML/CSS.

- Keep all files in the root directory unless otherwise specified.
